name: scribe
description: Turn what a patient describes, or a clinical document they hand over, into structured medical records a human can check. Bundles the clinical-scribe skill + the hosted Scribe MCP server (scribe.maxhealth.tech), which validates every resource against its IPS profile and verifies codes against a real terminology server. Nothing is saved: each result is a draft for someone to accept. Sign in with your Max Health account on first use.
